slides.texte_overlay:
What makes some guys
stand apart in their 20s
They take responsibility early. No blaming parents, bosses or luck. Owning your life at twenty-two puts you years ahead.
They learn to cook, clean and budget. Basic life skills give you freedom and make you someone people can rely on.
They keep in shape. Not for likes, for energy. A strong, healthy body makes every other goal easier. Train for life.
They travel when they can. Even cheap trips. Seeing other places and cultures makes them more open and interesting.
Before: I spent my free time scrolling. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and I finally feel like I'm growing.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: I spent my free time scrolling. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. I finally feel like I'm growing.

slides.texte_overlay: They choose friends who push them. Ambitious, honest, kind. Your circle in your 20s shapes the man you become. Choose well.
They're patient with results. They know real success takes years and keep going while others give up. Time rewards them.
